# 🚀 Deployment Checklist

## Target and scope
- Host:
- Branch/commit:
- Published path:
- Owner:

## Pre-deployment
- [ ] Required HTML files included.
- [ ] Relative asset folders preserved.
- [ ] README links checked.
- [ ] No secrets or private data included.
- [ ] Browser validation completed.

## Deployment verification
- [ ] Each exercise URL loads.
- [ ] Images load.
- [ ] Console output matches expected behavior.
- [ ] Mobile viewport remains usable.
- [ ] HTTPS and host configuration checked where applicable.

## Rollback
State the last known-good commit and restoration procedure.

## Evidence
Add verified URLs, screenshots, and timestamp.
